column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Huh? You can't? What do you mean by that?!
Even I get embarrassed at some things...
And I looked after you so much... Somehow, this makes me sad...
Huh? K-Kirino?
I-I didn't mean it like that!
I'm just doing you a favor by making you into an outstanding otaku that anyone can recognize.
Is that really a favor?
That's why you're such a fickle!
Huh? A fickle?
A fickle otaku. Are you okay with that?
Well, it's not like I really wanted to try so hard at being one...
Of course you're not. So I'll teach you from step one.
You're totally not listening...
Is it good... or... Huh? Does it taste bad?
What's with that Hiyori'd line?
Huh?!
The number one thing you must have to be a true otaku...
Right, right. What is it?
As I said, go buy those things.
Ah, no matter what I won't be able to refuse, I see...
It's totally for your benefit! Really! Trust me!
I don't want that "benefit"!
It'll be alright! C'mon, c'mon!
So it comes back to that!
This is something that's necessary for you.
Number 2. Be honest with your materialistic desires.
The things you desire come once in a lifetime. A moment's hesitation and they're gone. In order to avoid regretting not buying, buy without regrets.
It's like some kind of proverb...
So c'mon, go buy those things without complaining.
Do I really have to buy them?
Of course!
Why do you seem so happy about this?
Shame can make you not buy it, but you'll regret it afterwards.
I totally understand how that feels.
I'm not going to regret it!
Honestly speaking, you're the one who wants them, right?
...Why are you making such a baseless assumption?
